rationale: ROUND 3 on corr 7b0e2833. Round 2's gating question (is the edit_live writer path guarded against the missingkey=zero blanking family?) was worked, and it EXPOSED A REAL DEFECT in the round-2 plan, now fixed and measured — plus the second bug_historian prediction also came true and is fixed and measured. (1) THE GATING ANSWER, in three parts: (a) the conversion path renders through render_component, which IS the guarded call site — missingRequiredLLMFields at v3_site_actions.go:1843 (call at :2066-2079) refuses to render a section whose required source:llm fields are empty, and the PBP-032 envelope render guard (render_content_envelope_guard.go) covers the schema-blind population at the same seam; (b) validate_content stands between writer and save on the same handler chain, and the canary MEASURED it failing CLOSED: the writer's output was refused ('0 blockers, 1 errors'), the component's content_data and rendered_html stayed byte-identical; (c) but the guard analysis exposed that the one live 'partial' row's missing fields are source=site_assets.* STRINGS (card1_image_url: {type: url, source: site_assets.image, required: true}) — fields the render gate is deliberately blind to and the prose writer can only MINT urls for. Seed v2 therefore added an asset_sourced route: any still-empty field whose schema source is site_assets.* PARKS with the asset-pipeline routing fact instead of converting; the classifier reads the component schema per field (legacy dialect defaults llm, matching SchemaContentFields). The category-error conversion item was cancelled with a resolution note. (2) bug_historian's no_plan_generic prediction: measured by running that exact row as canary #5 — the recreate no-opped at mark_no_ready_sections, AND the round-2 'committed fallback' (ensure_page_section_layout) was investigated and REJECTED on code reading: defaultSectionsForPage (apply_gap_plan_action.go:959-997) has NO blog-index archetype and would hand a listing page hero+generic-text+CTA. Seed v3 splits the route: no_plan_generic converts only for page_type ''/content/landing (the generic default's home turf); index-family pages park as no_plan_unbuildable naming the owning machinery (needs_blog_posts -> blog-content-planner, bugs 015/206). The no-op conversion item was cancelled with a note. (3) The proliferation tripwire is now a TRACKED ARTIFACT, not prose: architecture_review/RFC_030 files the fourth-router-must-propose-the-engine rule with the three seats' objections quoted; CQ-023 points at it. (4) guardian's single-active-row concern: the seed's verify block now asserts exactly ONE active definition row for the type. (5) FACTS THAT MOVED UNDER US, stated plainly: the producer Go change is ALREADY LIVE — another lane's roll to v1.0.1302 (uniform image across all 25 chassis pods; stamp 194907d5b... carries commit 5ad81182b by git merge-base; literal probe 1 with negative control 0) shipped it mid-session, so new items of this type are born triaged at the router now. This is the estate's stated 'review is after the fact, by design' reality (owner ruling 2026-07-29 §2). Fleet assignment of the ~40 backlog rows remains HELD for this verdict.
